identity_model.principle: Resolve every telemetry payload to exactly one CI via ordered match_rules; instance keys require their host (scope_parent) to resolve first.
identity_model.resolution_order: highest priority matching rule wins; ties broken by scope specificity then confidence
identity_model.ambiguity_policy: if >1 CI matches or none does, emit to unresolved bucket keyed by raw attributes; never silently mis-attach
